text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit eastbound and westbound U-turns at all times on Freshmeadow Drive, between Townsend Road and the east leg of Song Meadoway (private road). Arbor Glen Public School is located on the south side of this section of Freshmeadow Drive. The proposed prohibition will enhance safety for students of Arbor Glen Public School and improve traffic flow on Freshmeadow Drive.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turns at all times on Freshmeadow Drive, between Townsend Road and a point 195 metres east.
